description: An open-fronted smithy with a hand-cranked blower on the hearth and a drop hammer worked off the overhead line shaft. Tongs on the wall in order of jaw. A quench trough with a skin on it. What comes out of here is made to be taken apart again: everything on the finished rack is pinned or bolted, and there is not one weld on any of it that could not be cut with a hacksaw by somebody standing where you are.
name: The Forge
